selection_rule: the default on-device assistant model, pinned to a released quantised GGUF from its project's official source; the digest is the SHA-256 of that file; it is fetched into the ignored .models/ directory and never committed, so a fresh device has a working assistant with no configuration

models.name: assistant
models.purpose: The default on-device assistant model the home command bar answers with — a small instruction-tuned model, quantised so it loads and runs on a laptop CPU. Provisioned into .models/ by `zig build fetch-model` and discovered automatically at run.
